# Speech test recordings

Short 16 kHz mono recordings for the speech tests (`tests/speech.test.mjs`): the wake phrase
in five voices, with and without a request after it, and three sentences that must not wake
Jarvis ("no-…"). They were synthesized with the project's own voice engine — Kokoro-82M
(Apache-2.0) voices bm_george, bf_emma, bm_lewis, am_michael and af_heart — so they contain
no one's real voice and are free to redistribute.
